story_review.one_viewing_summary: Intended chain from code, not observed. A camera head atop a tower turns while its round display pans the dry land, then pulls back to the whole tower and its ring. 16 of 56 lens rings light. In the display a plume rises and a flag locks on it. An alert card slides out to a truck below and lands as a bubble on the dash phone in the cab. The dash clock shows a hatched window up to ten minutes, marked estimated. In the display the plume keeps burning under the locked flag. Wide, a dashed line runs from the truck to a fire-station badge and, as drawn, touches it. A calendar clipped under the visors has no red mark. A blank record lies on the tailgate. The plan folder waits on state approval above the display, the landed alert and a line that again touches the badge.
story_review.opening_to_ending: Opens on what the camera sees and shows the alert reaching the crew truck by about 17 s. Its ending shows the line to responders apparently closed, so the stated limit is not pictured.
story_review.weakest_transition: s4-shot-2 to s5-shot-1: from the dash clock in the cab straight back into the lens display with no physical bridge.
